format_note: Two vector classes below use different formats deliberately: derivation vectors (01-02) mirror canoncheck/vectors-axes (raw envelope/preimage + expected canonical bytes + expected digest) since that tooling is the one AXES-adjacent harness actually operational today (per MarkovianProtocol's published vectors and validate.py). confirmation_predicate vectors (03-06) have no existing cross-project harness to target yet — AXES's own repo has no general-purpose validator published (Tersign's 2026-07-27 comment on axes#6: tools/README.md lists validator/ as Planned P4). These are shaped as data + a stated predicate + a worked-example reference, ready to be re-shaped once AXES's vector schema is frozen.
source_of_confirmation_vectors: docs/spec/guarantee-model.md, section "confirmation_predicate per backend" (added commit 66fd62f) — one vector per table row.
known_gap_disclosed: On-chain confirmation_predicate (03) is the TARGET, not yet enforced in code: arb_pay.py writes tx_hash at broadcast time and does not poll for the receipt, so PENDING/non-null never transitions to an explicit COMMITTED write today. Stated in guarantee-model.md and repeated here so this vector set does not imply otherwise.
